# Empty-mbox review narrowed EOF handling and preserved callback timing

The initial attempt to tolerate EOF failed the bad-storeToken telemetry test and was replaced with a different implementation. The review required BeginScan callbacks to occur after the method returns. The immediate empty-file fix was accepted while broader parser and null-message design work was deferred. This supports the narrow empty-scan and callback lessons linked below; it does not establish a general rule that EOF is harmless.

The added empty-mbox test was accepted. Its title, review acceptance and completed build do not establish a passing test observed during this study.
